title: myDMentor
tagline: A blockchain-based web application that connects expert mentors with mentees across various subjects, facilitating mentorship opportunities and knowledge exchange.
description:
We are developing a unique platform that serves as a bridge between consultants/mentors and clients, focusing on the reverse engineering of freelancing principles. The platform’s unique feature lies in providing the desired hunger of knowledge in specialized point, redefining the traditional freelancing model.
Our platform not only redefines the consultancy and mentorship experience but also provides a secure and innovative space for individuals to connect, learn, and grow.
By combining innovative features with a user-centric design, our platform aims to revolutionize the consulting and mentoring industry. We look forward to your valuable feedback and suggestions for further improvement.
how_its_made: In our project, we utilized React and JavaScript on the frontend, deploying smart contracts written in Solidity to the Polygon zkEVM testnet. For chat functionalities, we implemented the push protocol, while adopting Worldcoin protocols for verifiable ID and authentication. Additionally, we integrated Metamask on the frontend to ensure secure user interactions.
